front.title: SCITT Profile for Portable AI Agent Package Provenance

abstract.t:
Portable AI agent packages can contain executable or interpretable behavior, prompts, workflow graphs, tool schemas, dependencies, and declarations of execution requirements. Such packages may be authored, transformed, repackaged, scanned, approved, published, superseded, and withdrawn by different parties before they are executed by an independent runtime.
This document describes a SCITT application profile for transparent provenance of portable AI agent packages. It maps the package lifecycle to the SCITT architecture, identifies an immutable package digest as the artifact binding point, and defines classes of supply- chain statements that can be made about a package without defining a new statement payload format. Examples include authorship, build and transformation, execution-profile conformance, security assessment, publication, approval, supersession, and withdrawal statements.
This document does not define a portable-agent package format, agent execution protocol, runtime authorization model, or per-action execution receipt. It complements SCITT profiles that record agent actions or sessions by focusing on the provenance of the agent package before and across deployment.
